title: Anthropic's New Claude Tag Is a Huge Productivity Upgrade
description:
Anthropic has introduced Claude Tag, a new AI feature that lets you assign tasks by simply tagging Claude inside your team chat. Instead of opening a chatbot, Claude works in the background, updates your team as it makes progress, handles recurring tasks, investigates issues, and automates workflows.

Anthropic also revealed that Claude now helps write around 65% of its internal product code, showing how AI is becoming an active teammate instead of just another tool.

If you're interested in AI productivity, AI agents, automation, and the future of work, this update is worth watching.
